title: Customer and ledger API choices
decision: One entry is between 100 and 100 000 000 UZS; a reversal that would make the balance negative is refused until the later payment is reversed; SUBSCRIPTION_LIMITED answers 402 and SHOP_SUSPENDED answers 403; a shop with no subscription record is treated as limited; in a suspended shop only the owner may view; lists and totals are computed in SQL and checked against the domain rules by a test; measurement rows refer to a shop and an entry by a derived value (UUID version 5 with a fixed namespace); a nine-digit phone number is taken as an Uzbek number; ruff rule S608 is replaced for the storage module by a stricter project test
context: Decided by an agent during the autonomous build under DEC-020; implemented and awaiting the founder's review
chosen_option: Choices as listed in pull request 15
rationale: The approved documents set no amount bounds or status codes. The bounds stop typing mistakes such as a missing or extra digit group. A derived measurement reference is opaque to a reader of the measurement schema but can be recomputed by anyone who holds the shop identifier, which is weaker than a secret salt and is flagged here
